resumen: Standing, the bar goes from the shoulders to overhead. The whole trunk works to avoid arching while the shoulders press.
ejecucion: Unrack the bar at chest height, or clean it there if you know how: this card starts with the bar already resting on the upper chest.
Stand with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your elbows in front of the bar.
Squeeze glutes and abs: that is what keeps the back from arching as you press.
Tuck your chin to let the bar pass and press straight up.
As soon as the bar clears your forehead, move your head back under it: the lockout ends with the bar over the crown of your head, not in front of your face.
Lower it under control until it rests on your chest again.
matices: There is no single overhead press: behind the neck brings out more rear and side delt, in front brings in more chest, and with a barbell the body stabilises more than on a machine. What it works depends on which one you do.
